item_activity_xiranite_bottle.title: Experimental Xiranite Bottle
item_activity_xiranite_bottle.d1: A container made by processing Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_bottle.d2: A gourd-shaped Xiranite bottle. Many Wulingers dreamed of traveling the world armed with a sword and a gourd.

item_activity_xiranite_cmpt.title: Experimental Xiranite Part
item_activity_xiranite_cmpt.d1: A part made by processing Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_cmpt.d2: This experimental Xiranite part has a rather limited range of applications.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_bottle.title: Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle
item_activity_xiranite_enr_bottle.d1: A large-capacity container made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_bottle.d2: A larger, thicker, and heavier gourd-shaped Xiranite bottle. In fact, it is so thick and heavy that people think it could be used as a component for an exotic weapon.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_cmpt.title: Experimental Heavy Xiranite Part
item_activity_xiranite_enr_cmpt.d1: A part made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_cmpt.d2: This experimental Heavy Xiranite part has a rather limited range of applications.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_hulu.title: Xiranite Jade Gourd
item_activity_xiranite_enr_hulu.d1: A large-capacity protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as Fruits of Altruism Certs.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_hulu.d2:
A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. This particular version has a larger Xiranite capacity than the standard variant. If the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.

"A beautiful gourd that can bail me out."

item_activity_xiranite_enr_tool.title: Experimental Xiran-Hue Atomizer
item_activity_xiranite_enr_tool.d1: A component made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_tool.d2: A special Xiranite atomizer that can effectively accelerate Xiranite dispersion. Design inspirations are derived from the famous poetry anthology titled Clouds and Sunsets.

item_activity_xiranite_hulu.title: Xiranite Gourd
item_activity_xiranite_hulu.d1: A protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as Fruits of Altruism Certs.
item_activity_xiranite_hulu.d2:
A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. Nevertheless, if the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.

"A round-bellied gourd with a pouty snout."

item_activity_copper_poly.title: Proto Xiran-Cuprium
item_activity_copper_poly.d1: A metal ingot made by transmuting Proto Xiran-Cuprium Gas during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly.d2: An experimental type of Xiran-Cuprium that is lighter compared to the standard type of the same material. However, it is also more brittle.

item_activity_copper_poly_cmpt.title: Proto Xiran-Cuprium Part
item_activity_copper_poly_cmpt.d1: A part made by processing Proto Xiran-Cuprium during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly_cmpt.d2: An experimental Xiran-Cuprium Part that is more resistant to material wear and fatigue compared to the standard part.

item_activity_copper_poly_gas.title: Proto Xiran-Cuprium Gas
item_activity_copper_poly_gas.d1: A novel gas created by reacting Cuprium Gas with Xiragen during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly_gas.d2: An experimental type of Xiran-Cuprium Gas that is easier to transport and store compared to the standard type of the same gas.

item_activity_copper_poly_tool.title: Proto Xiran-Cuprium Frame
item_activity_copper_poly_tool.d1: A reinforced support frame made by processing Proto Xiran-Cuprium Parts and Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly_tool.d2: A chassis frame absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung! And it's EXTRA-STRONG!

item_activity_copper_xiranite_tool.title: Proto Cuprium Frame
item_activity_copper_xiranite_tool.d1: A support frame made by processing Cuprium Parts and Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_xiranite_tool.d2: A chassis frame absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung!

item_activity_xiranite_box.title: Proto Chubby Lung Shell
item_activity_xiranite_box.d1: A shell component made by processing Proto Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_box.d2: A piece of outer casing absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung!

item_activity_xiranite_enr_box.title: Proto Chubby Lung Heavy Shell
item_activity_xiranite_enr_box.d1: A thick shell component made by processing Proto Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_box.d2: A piece of outer casing absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung! And it's EXTRA-THICK!

item_activity_xiranite_enr_lung.title: Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung
item_activity_xiranite_enr_lung.d1: An improved Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as [[Fruits of Altruism Certs (Chubby Lung Attacks)
item_activity_xiranite_enr_lung.d2: Fruits of Altruism Certs]].|Powerful! Cute! Automated! And UNSTOPPABLE!

item_activity_xiranite_enr_nugget.title: Proto Heavy Xiranite
item_activity_xiranite_enr_nugget.d1: A piece of crystalline Heavy Xiranite made during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_nugget.d2: A piece of Heavy Xiranite with a rather unique crystalline structure. This seems to be the product of a special experiment and exhibits very unusual levels of activity.

item_activity_xiranite_lung.title: Xiranite Chubby Lung
item_activity_xiranite_lung.d1: A Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as [[Fruits of Altruism Certs (Chubby Lung Attacks)
item_activity_xiranite_lung.d2: Fruits of Altruism Certs]].|Powerful! Cute! Automated!

item_activity_xiranite_nugget.title: Proto Xiranite
item_activity_xiranite_nugget.d1: A piece of crystalline Xiranite made during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_nugget.d2: A piece of Xiranite with a rather unique crystalline structure. This seems to be the product of a special experiment and exhibits very unusual levels of activity.

item_carbon_enr.title: Stabilized Carbon
item_carbon_enr.d1: Multiple processing steps have achieved a delicate balance for this brick of elemental carbon.

item_carbon_enr_powder.title: Dense Carbon Powder
item_carbon_enr_powder.d1: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to create this uniquely fine powdered preparation of Carbon.

item_carbon_mtl.title: Carbon
item_carbon_mtl.d1: During the war, Endfield Industries managed to optimize their waste emission carbon capture technology.

item_carbon_powder.title: Carbon Powder
item_carbon_powder.d1: Carbon can be shredded to yield a powdered product.

item_bottled_food_4.title: Jincao Drink
item_bottled_food_4.d1: A carbonated beverage with a dash of jincao herbal extract. The refreshing aroma made this a popular drink.

item_copper_cmpt.title: Cuprium Part
item_copper_cmpt.d1: A device part made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.
item_copper_cmpt.d2: A Cuprium Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_bottle.title: Cuprium Bottle
item_copper_bottle.d1: A metallic bottle made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for filling fluids.
item_copper_bottle.d2: Cuprium bottles are pretty rare in the market because Cuprium is a more expensive metal than Ferrium.

item_bottled_food_5.title: Jincao Tea
item_bottled_food_5.d1: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_bottled_food_5.d2: A carbonated beverage made with jincao herbs. The process of preparation is based on time-tested herbal therapeutic traditions.

item_fbottle_copperenr_copper.title: Hetonite Bottle
item_fbottle_copperenr_copper.d1: A metallic bottle made by moulding Hetonite. Can be used to produce other items.
item_fbottle_copperenr_copper.d2: A metallic bottle that is hardly available on the market. Hetonite has a hue so alluring that even a common Hetonite bottle is considered a collector item for many people.

item_copper_enr.title: Hetonite
item_copper_enr.d1: Hetonite is acquired via replacement-precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_copper_enr.d2: A novel material that sparkles and gleams. The Tianshi have great hopes for this metal and thus named it Hetonite (literal meaning: bright red cuprium). Perhaps they caught a glimpse of hope for humanity within the flaming, crimson hues.

item_copper_enr_cmpt.title: Hetonite Part
item_copper_enr_cmpt.d1: A device part made by processing Hetonite. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.
item_copper_enr_cmpt.d2: A Hetonite Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_enr2.title: Pyrrolite
item_copper_enr2.d1: A solid piece of metal acquired by transmuting Pyrrolite Gas at the Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_copper_enr2.d2: Like Hetonite, this metal has been highlighted for its industrial and manufacturing potential. The Tianshi called it Pyrrolite based on the word "pyrrhos" with the hope that the metal could generate intense heat and give birth to humanity's passion for building a new future.

item_copper_enr2_cmpt.title: Pyrrolite Part
item_copper_enr2_cmpt.d1: A device part made by processing Pyrrolite. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.
item_copper_enr2_cmpt.d2: A Pyrrolite Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_jar.title: Cuprium Canister
item_copper_jar.d1: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_copper_jar.d2: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_crystal_enr.title: Packed Origocrust
item_crystal_enr.d1: The Packed Origocrust is a result of multiple processing steps and looks just like a piece of precious "gemstone".

item_crystal_enr_powder.title: Dense Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_enr_powder.d1: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to prepare this dense powdered form of Origocrust with particles almost invisible to the unaided eye.

item_crystal_powder.title: Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_powder.d1: Origocrust can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_crystal_shell.title: Origocrust
item_crystal_shell.d1: The thickness of the crystalline crust encasing an Originium formation (referred to as Origocrust) is often used to determine the age of the Originium vein.

item_equip_script_2.title: Ferrium Component
item_equip_script_2.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_2.d2: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with ferrium for better ejection than the common variant.

item_equip_script_3.title: Cryston Component
item_equip_script_3.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_3.d2: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with cryston for easier use.

item_equip_script_4.title: Xiranite Component
item_equip_script_4.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4.d2: The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Highly Transparent Xiranite Mould. The main materials for constructing this are Packed Origocrust and Xiranite. This mould offers better data transduction when compared to the standard variant.

item_equip_script_1.title: Amethyst Component
item_equip_script_1.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_1.d2: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. Amethyst is the main material used for producing this.

item_copper_ore.title: Cuprium Ore
item_copper_ore.d1: A reddish metal that can be processed with the AIC Factory.
item_copper_ore.d2: A natural mineral complex unique to the Wuling region. Metals acquired by refining this ore form the basis for local industry and production.

item_copper_nugget.title: Cuprium
item_copper_nugget.d1: A metallic ingot made by refining Cuprium Ore. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_copper_nugget.d2: Smelted Cuprium is no longer soft nor prone to oxidation.

item_copper_powder.title: Cuprium Powder
item_copper_powder.d1: Shredded and powdered Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items.
item_copper_powder.d2: Products made using shredded Cuprium yield a more homogenized texture.

item_equip_script_4_1.title: Cuprium Component
item_equip_script_4_1.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4_1.d2: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Cuprium is the main material used for producing this.

item_equip_script_4_2.title: Hetonite Component
item_equip_script_4_2.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4_2.d2: The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Hetonite is the main material used for producing this. It also features higher Xiranite capacity than its cuprium counterpart.

item_equip_script_4_3.title: Pyrrolite Component
item_equip_script_4_3.d1: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4_3.d2: The full name of this component is a Multifaceted Core-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Pyrrolite is the main material used for producing this. It also features higher Xiranite capacity than its lower tier counterparts.

item_glass_bottle.title: Amethyst Bottle
item_glass_bottle.d1: A bottle made by processing Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_glass_bottle.d2: Amethyst bottles are being phased out from markets in the Civilization Band due to its fragility, weight, and Blight resistance.

item_iron_bottle.title: Ferrium Bottle
item_iron_bottle.d1: A metallic bottle made by processing Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_bottle.d2: A metallic bottle rarely seen in the market. Although ferrium metal offers better resistance against oxidation, people still prefer the steel variant.

item_glass_enr_bottle.title: Cryston Bottle
item_glass_enr_bottle.d1: A metallic bottle made by processing Cryston Fibers. Can be used to produce other items.
item_glass_enr_bottle.d2: Special chemical reagents can only be properly stored with Cryston Bottles. An example would be the notorious aqua mordax, otherwise known as the "corroding water" or localized ferric chloride solvent.

item_iron_enr_bottle.title: Steel Bottle
item_iron_enr_bottle.d1: A metallic bottle made by moulding Steel. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_enr_bottle.d2: A bottle made of steel, the most common of its kind in the market.

item_glass_cmpt.title: Amethyst Part
item_glass_cmpt.d1: An Amethyst part with a wide range of uses.

item_gas_inert.title: Inergen
item_gas_inert.d1: A stable gas. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.
item_gas_inert.d2: A special gas that can be purified and extracted using AIC Factory facilities. They said it was first used in pneumatic valves and fittings during the original launching of Dijiang.

item_filter_core.title: Separator Core
item_filter_core.d1: A filter device. Can be used to purify gaseous materials.
item_filter_core.d2: The engineers are currently trying to upgrade facility-grade filter modules. Once the Separator Cores can be recycled and reused, the cost in industrial materials will be greatly reduced.

item_gas_acid.title: Acridgen
item_gas_acid.d1: The gaseous state of Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_acid.d2: When transmuting Precipitation Acid, scientists accidentally discovered numerous properties atypical of other acidic materials. "Activity levels look a bit off, but don't worry... I don't think they'll turn back into the Aggeloi..."

item_gas_copper.title: Cuprium Gas
item_gas_copper.d1: The gaseous state of Cuprium. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_copper.d2: PPE must be properly worn when operating the Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit. Do not be misled by the innocuous-looking red vapors. They can set a person's soul on fire.

item_gas_copper_enr.title: Hetonite Gas
item_gas_copper_enr.d1: The gaseous state of Hetonite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_copper_enr.d2: When the metal was transmuted into vapors that bore a far more intense and brilliant hue of red, several lines of data danced upon the test monitoring the log. The Tianshi studied them and saw the theoretical potential for creating Pyrrolite.

item_gas_copper_enr2.title: Pyrrolite Gas
item_gas_copper_enr2.d1: The gaseous state of Pyrrolite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_copper_enr2.d2: A number of scientists believe that Pyrrolite Gas can be weaponized. Gently unleash it and watch the enemy downwind disintegrate at a visible rate.

item_gas_water.title: Aquagen
item_gas_water.d1: The gaseous state of Clean Water. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_water.d2: "Since the great tide burst and roared, clean rippling waters disappeared, only to be replenished by the cycle of rain and vapor."

item_gas_xiranite.title: Xiragen
item_gas_xiranite.d1: The gaseous state of Xiranite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_xiranite.d2: "The soil nurtures numerous qi that connects every living being."

item_gas_xiranite_enr.title: Heavy Xiragen
item_gas_xiranite_enr.d1: The gaseous state of Heavy Xiranite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_xiranite_enr.d2: To protect the innate "dynamic equilibrium" of Heavy Xiranite during the transmutation process, the engineers furnished the instruments with additional real-time monitoring and modulating modules.

item_iron_enr_cmpt.title: Steel Part
item_iron_enr_cmpt.d1: A Steel Part with a wide range of uses.

item_glass_enr_cmpt.title: Cryston Part
item_glass_enr_cmpt.d1: A Cryston Part with a wide range of uses.

item_iron_cmpt.title: Ferrium Part
item_iron_cmpt.d1: A Ferrium Part with a wide range of uses.

item_iron_enr.title: Steel
item_iron_enr.d1: Steel manufactured by Endfield Industries has been subject to multiple processing steps. It has been included in the list of Grade 2 Reference Materials in the Talos-II Blight Resistance Standards of Industrial Metals.

item_iron_enr_powder.title: Dense Ferrium Powder
item_iron_enr_powder.d1: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this preparation of dense Ferrium powder. It is extremely popular amongst traditional artists.

item_iron_powder.title: Ferrium Powder
item_iron_powder.d1: Ferrium can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_iron_nugget.title: Ferrium
item_iron_nugget.d1: A metal of Talos-II that is remarkably similar to Oriron. No one could explain the similarity.

item_iron_ore.title: Ferrium Ore
item_iron_ore.d1: Many theories have been proposed about the origins of Ferrium. Before the age of industrial metallurgy, Ferrium was the most common metal that people used.

item_liquid_plant_grass_1.title: Jincao Solution
item_liquid_plant_grass_1.d1: A solution prepared to maximize the effects of jincao extract.

item_liquid_plant_grass_2.title: Yazhen Solution
item_liquid_plant_grass_2.d1: A solution prepared to maximize the effects of yazhen extract.

item_liquid_water.title: Clean Water
item_liquid_water.d1: It has always been the source of life.

item_liquid_xiranite.title: Liquid Xiranite
item_liquid_xiranite.d1: Xiranite dissolved in Clean Water. Can be used to produce other materials. Often filled in containers and loaded on jet drones for Liquid Xiranite spraying and elimination of Active Blight in Wuling.
item_liquid_xiranite.d2: When people first hear about aqueous Xiranite solutions, most would regard its production as a simple process. However, a user without proper equipment nor techniques would only arrive at a useless product — one that is hardly any different than sand mixed in water.

item_liquid_sewage.title: Sewage
item_liquid_sewage.d1: Sewage is basically water with all sorts of suspended and/or dissolved materials. It must be processed at a Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.
item_liquid_sewage.d2: Sewage and polluted bodies of water found in the wildlands often contain a plethora of contaminants. Advanced technology is required to clean them properly.

item_liquid_acid.title: Precipitation Acid
item_liquid_acid.d1: Precipitation Acid is capable of dissolving various chemically resistant materials. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.
item_liquid_acid.d2: Aggeloid remains would turn into a corrosive fluid when subject to abnormal levels of heat and pressure. In the process of Aggeloid formation, Ankhors would simply (and violently) "mash" the constituent inorganic materials of an Aggelos together to precipitate various reactions otherwise impossible in the real world. When Aggeloid remains are broken down, these unusual inorganic materials would undergo further changes. This is how the Precipitation Acid is made.

item_liquid_copper.title: Cuprium Solution
item_liquid_copper.d1: A solution of materials dissolved in Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_liquid_copper.d2: "I wish to head north and drill a well in the tundra, brother. The watering hole might be the very first human-dug well on Talos-II. We probably won't get anything drinkable out of it, but the water might look pretty, at least."

item_liquid_copper_enr.title: Hetonite Solution
item_liquid_copper_enr.d1: A solution acquired by refining the Cuprium Solution. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_liquid_copper_enr.d2: The Ankhors would attract metallic ions from the depths of the Hongshan Crater Lake to assemble the Aggeloi. These beings would then be subject to various steps of "forging" to achieve better performances. The Tianshi of Wuling have now mastered this process to achieve large-scale metal precipitation.

item_liquid_xiranite_enr.title: Liquid Heavy Xiranite
item_liquid_xiranite_enr.d1: Heavy Xiranite dissolved in Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials. Often filled in containers and loaded on jet drones for Liquid Heavy Xiranite spraying and elimination of Active Blight in Wuling.
item_liquid_xiranite_enr.d2: In addition to countering the Blight, another key focus of Xiranite tech research is the identification of potential Xiranite compounds with other materials.

item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.title: Aketine Powder
item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.d1: It is easier to extract target materials and substances from shredded Aketine.

item_plant_grass_powder_2.title: Yazhen Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_2.d1: Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_powder_1.title: Jincao Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_1.d1: Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_originium_enr_powder.title: Dense Originium Powder
item_originium_enr_powder.d1: The UWST Originium cultivation project initially attempted "powder seeding" but the resulting crystal clusters would often lose their activity quickly.

item_originium_ore.title: Originium Ore
item_originium_ore.d1: A raw formation of Originium unearthed in its most natural form. This can be processed in the AIC
item_originium_ore.d2: A basic mineral necessary to support most industrial production.

item_originium_powder.title: Originium Powder
item_originium_powder.d1: Endfield made use of Techno-Protocol to create a stable form of Originium Powder.

item_plant_moss_2.title: Citrome
item_plant_moss_2.d1: A fruit that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make food or materials for other products.
item_plant_moss_2.d2: Citromes are part of the botanical genus of Zitros that usually grows in the central continental region of Talos-II. The species and cultivars grown in the Civilization Band tend to yield large fruits with tough, fibrous flesh.

item_plant_moss_3.title: Sandleaf
item_plant_moss_3.d1: A plant with extremely rough leaves that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC. Shred it to get a powdered preparation usable in industrial grinding.
item_plant_moss_3.d2: The Hannabit Circuit proved themselves as the true masters of wilderness crafting and would use all sorts of natural materials to aid in their crafting.

item_plant_bbflower_1.title: Aketine
item_plant_bbflower_1.d1: Aketine is a species of flora native to Talos-II. It usually grows at places with unique soil composition.

item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.title: Aketine Seed
item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.d1: Nitrates can be extracted from Aketine. Scientists believe this is caused by the absorption of rainwater with excessively high levels of Blighted materials.

item_plant_grass_1.title: Jincao
item_plant_grass_1.d1: The jincao plant is commonly known as the "silkstar grass", named after the star-like flowers of the plant. The plant usually grows on shaded hillslopes.

item_plant_grass_2.title: Yazhen
item_plant_grass_2.d1: The yazhen plant is an extremely hardy grass native to the Wuling region. The plant produces a rather beautiful bloom during summer.

item_plant_grass_seed_1.title: Jincao Seed
item_plant_grass_seed_1.d1: Children in the frontier enjoy blowing two jincao leaves placed together to give off a sound that resembles a roaring beast.

item_muck_feces_1.title: Burdo-Muck
item_muck_feces_1.d1:
Burdo-Muck provides all sorts of nutrients to the soil. 
If you see a burdenbeast in the wilderness, give it a gentle pat to get yourself a huge, mucking pat of hot, steaming surprise.

item_muck_xiranite_1.title: Bumper-Rich
item_muck_xiranite_1.d1: A fertilizer made by mixing burdo-muck with Liquid Xiranite. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to increase (double) its harvest yield.
item_muck_xiranite_1.d2:
Processed burdo-muck fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize planting plots. 
"Plop a bar of Bumper-Rich to your beautiful fields! Who'd say no to 88 tons per acre yield?"

item_plant_moss_1.title: Buckflower
item_plant_moss_1.d1: A plant with brightly colored flowers that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make medication or materials for other products.
item_plant_moss_1.d2: When the War just began, a Hongshan recon team discovered a plant with brightly colored flowers. Extracts of this plant can be used as an anti-hemorrhagic agent.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.title: Ground Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.d1: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this buckflower preparation with "strangely" improved pharmaceutical activity.

item_liquid_xiranite_lowpoly.title: Inert Xircon Effluent
item_liquid_xiranite_lowpoly.d1: A solution acquired by chemically reacting Liquid Xiranite with Sewage. It must be processed at the Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.
item_liquid_xiranite_lowpoly.d2: A type of Xircon Effluent from various applications that completely exhausted the energy of its Originium constituents. Only a minute fraction of Feranmut power has entered an active state. Such effluents can largely be regarded as chemically inert.

item_liquid_xiranite_poly.title: Xircon Effluent
item_liquid_xiranite_poly.d1: A solution acquired by chemically reacting Liquid Xiranite with Sewage. It can be used to produce other materials, or processed at the Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.
item_liquid_xiranite_poly.d2: Xircon Effluent is a form of partially inactivated Liquid Xiranite, but a fraction of its constituents remains in a hyperactive state. Energy of the Originium constituents within Liquid Xiranite gradually dissipates during various applications. This "desiccation" process would occasionally trigger the activation of Feranmut power within the Xiranite.

item_plant_moss_powder_3.title: Sandleaf Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_3.d1: Shredding releases the abrasive grit from sandleaf tissues for industrial use.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.title: Ground Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.d1: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Citrome preparation with an extremely bitter taste.

item_plant_moss_powder_1.title: Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_1.d1: Shredding would greatly improve the pharmaceutical effectiveness of Buckflower.

item_plant_moss_powder_2.title: Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_2.d1: Shredding would greatly improve the flavors of Citrome.

item_plant_moss_seed_1.title: Buckflower Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_1.d1: Seeds picked from the Buckflower plant. Cultivate them to raise Buckflowers.
item_plant_moss_seed_1.d2: The Buckflower earned its name as it was first found under a natural arch that resembled a bucking, jumping beast.

item_plant_moss_seed_2.title: Citrome Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_2.d1: Seeds picked from the Citrome plant. Cultivate them to raise Citromes.
item_plant_moss_seed_2.d2: Hobby botanists and gardeners of the Civilization Band once voted for the Most Common Plants in the Wildlands. Buckflowers and Citromes both made it to the top 10 of the list.

item_plant_moss_seed_3.title: Sandleaf Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_3.d1: The history of wilderness crafting can be traced back nearly a century ago. People forced to live in the wildlands had to do everything they could to survive.

item_proc_battery_1.title: LC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_1.d1: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_1.d2: Use and handle with care. Contents are hazardous to health. Compromising casing integrity may cause the said contents to leak.

item_proc_battery_3.title: HC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_3.d1: Many wildlands settlers make a living by stripping waste batteries of recyclable materials.

item_proc_battery_4.title: LC Wuling Battery
item_proc_battery_4.d1: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_4.d2: Xiranite Power is a key project jointly pursued by Wuling and Endfield Industries.

item_proc_battery_2.title: SC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_2.d1: A skilled artisan can easily convert a standard capacity (SC) battery into an improvised explosive weapon.

item_quartz_enr_powder.title: Cryston Powder
item_quartz_enr_powder.d1: After fine grinding, improperly stored Cryston Powder will start to "flow" in non-hermetic containers due to Techno-Protocol influences.

item_quartz_enr.title: Cryston Fiber
item_quartz_enr.d1: Cryston Fibers can undergo various processing steps to create a material for transmitting data and communication signals.

item_quartz_glass.title: Amethyst Fiber
item_quartz_glass.d1: Factory-drawn Amethyst fibers exhibit vastly increased strength.

item_quartz_powder.title: Amethyst Powder
item_quartz_powder.d1: Amethyst can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_quartz_sand.title: Amethyst Ore
item_quartz_sand.d1: Amethyst has a wide range of uses in precision manufacturing. The crystal is one of the essential basic materials in the electronic industry of Talos-II.

item_xiranite_powder.title: Xiranite
item_xiranite_powder.d1: A material produced by a specialized facility. Can be used for repairing special facilities or for trading with various outposts.
item_xiranite_powder.d2: A novel Originium-based material acquired by fusing the mineral with Feranmut power. This material fuels life and prosperity in Wuling.

item_proc_bomb_1.title: Industrial Explosive
item_proc_bomb_1.d1:
A packaged explosive.
Can be used to directly attack targets. The resulting explosion deals damage to all nearby enemies.
item_proc_bomb_1.d2: This is a dangerous explosive. Carry and use with care.

item_proc_battery_5.title: SC Wuling Battery
item_proc_battery_5.d1: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_5.d2: The biggest advantage offered by this battery is zero risks of spontaneous combustion.

item_xiranite_poly.title: Xircon
item_xiranite_poly.d1: Acquired via crystal precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_xiranite_poly.d2: Introducing metallic elements has completely disrupted the balance between Originium and Feranmut power as well as the physical properties of the material itself. The Xircon crystals precipitated from the resulting effluent exhibit gemstone-like textures.

item_xiranite_enr_powder.title: Heavy Xiranite
item_xiranite_enr_powder.d1: A material produced by a specialized facility. Can be used for repairing special facilities or for trading with various outposts.
item_xiranite_enr_powder.d2: Heavy Xiranite was first discovered in an attempt to improve Xiranite yield. During the test, the Tianshi experimented with various Xiranite polymorphic mixtures and achieved a type of dynamic-static co-equilibrium. Though the test failed to achieve its aim, it yielded a form of Xiranite with a small yet significant improvement to durability.

item_bottled_food_1.title: Canned Citrome (C)
item_bottled_food_1.d1: A cheap can of citromes. This serves as an accessible source of vitamins for settlers in the wildlands.

item_bottled_food_2.title: Canned Citrome (B)
item_bottled_food_2.d1: Citrome now comes with revolutionary packaging. However, this was poorly received in the Civilization Band due to its excessive sugar content.

item_bottled_food_3.title: Canned Citrome (A)
item_bottled_food_3.d1: A can of citromes made with fruits grown in natural and wholesome orchards. Fortified with small amounts of the essential vitamin suite. However, suggested retail price seems to be higher than its worth.

item_bottled_rec_hp_1.title: Buck Capsule (C)
item_bottled_rec_hp_1.d1: A simple capsule made with crafting. It is quite leaky, and shaking it around might reduce its potency.

item_bottled_rec_hp_2.title: Buck Capsule (B)
item_bottled_rec_hp_2.d1: A capsule prepared using the processes of standard pharmaceutical packaging. Endfield Industries once tried to market this but the amount sold barely came to a fraction of the competing Rhodes Island product.

item_bottled_rec_hp_3.title: Buck Capsule (A)
item_bottled_rec_hp_3.d1: A capsule prepared using optimized packaging techniques. This Endfield product was designed for ease-of-use in combat scenarios.

item_bottled_rec_hp_4.title: Yazhen Syringe (C)
item_bottled_rec_hp_4.d1: Can only be administered via subcutaneous injection.

item_bottled_rec_hp_5.title: Yazhen Syringe (A)
item_bottled_rec_hp_5.d1: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_bottled_rec_hp_5.d2: Endfield Industries once attempted to develop a Protocol-Injection technology but the project was eventually canned. They ultimately lacked the courage to unleash something that would revolutionize the entire industry.

item_fbottle_copper_acid.title: Cuprium Bottle (Precipitation Acid)
item_fbottle_copper_acid.d1: A metallic bottle made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for filling fluids.
item_fbottle_copper_acid.d2: Cuprium bottles are pretty rare in the market because Cuprium is a more expensive metal than Ferrium.
